criteria.assertion: The workflow maps actual fixed-horizon, information-update, decision and evaluation units from business sources to claims and usable execution/receiving interfaces, without treating an existing reference configuration as validated authority.

Proposed evidence supports its stated scope; shorter-horizon or incomplete activity support does not silently verify full delivery reliability. An explicit source-bound gap and feasible next check is valid, without fixed experiment-count requirements.

Different consumer actually executes a meaningful proposed slice from raw inputs and checks the activated condition and relevant boundary, preserving uncovered mandatory outcomes and first failures; design or self-report alone is not run acceptance.

Fresh receiving context independently checks actual source/design/slice/claims and language, without author diagnoses, intended answers, prior results or invented quality/award quotas; unknown telemetry and limits remain explicit.

policy: No model, page, window or universal retry quota; original history preserved. Slice reception does not equal a complete modeling paper or skill causal improvement.
